title: HSK2 Gate 13 · Five Dynasties
explanationEn: Gate 13: Five Dynasties. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第13关：五代。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 有了纸以后，人们可以写书了。可是那时候的书都是一个字一个字写出来的。写一本书要很多天，有时候要几个月。所以书很少，也很贵。
passageEn: Once there was paper, people could write books. But books then were written out one character at a time. Writing one book took many days, sometimes months. So books were few, and expensive.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: Once there was paper, people could write books.
comprehension.answer: 有了纸以后，人们可以写书了。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: Writing one book took many days, sometimes months.
comprehension.answer: 写一本书要很多天，有时候要几个月。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 纸 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“纸”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 纸 (zhǐ) means "paper" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “纸”（zhǐ）的意思是“paper”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 以后 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“以后”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 以后 (yǐ hòu) means "after" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “以后”（yǐ hòu）的意思是“after”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 有了纸以后，人们可以写书了。

options.text: The water came into the fields, and into many people’s homes.
Once there was paper, people could write books.
Very long ago, it rained in China for many days.
Because there was so much rain, the water rose higher and higher.

check.explanationEn: "有了纸以后，人们可以写书了。" means "Once there was paper, people could write books.".
check.explanation: “有了纸以后，人们可以写书了。”的意思是“Once there was paper, people could write books.”。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Five Dynasties in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说五代。
